rulings: historic «Исторические достопримечательности» APPROVED over «Исторические места»: renders «المعالم التاريخية / Historic landmarks», is the plural of the verified kicker «Историческая достопримечательность», and is set apart from the section name «Достопримечательности» by its adjective exactly as ar sets «المعالم التاريخية» apart from «المعالم». Length checked on dist with headless Chrome: detail eyebrow .ah-k on /ru/attractions/qasr-ibrahim/ one line (305px of 343px at 375px viewport), card kicker .lc-k on /ru/attractions/ one line at 375px and 1440px; reads naturally as a category eyebrow above a site name (= de/ar plural). The section heading «Исторические достопримечательности» under H1 «Достопримечательности» reads as subset → set, intended. nav.attractions «Достопримечательности» and foot.col.site «О сайте» = owner decisions; header width absorbed by 28de9e8 (ru bar from 1518).
blind_disposition: No objection from the blind reader to any new name (Исторические достопримечательности, Природа, Достопримечательности, О сайте): nothing to apply or reject; «О сайте» is the reader's own earlier proposal. Remaining points are source-level IA questions in ar too (events naming, taste/crafts cards, plan guide vs tool, Discover column - reader proposes an «Об Аль-Ахсе» column, souqs+parks+farms) - logged for Eyad, unscored. «Начать историю», «Моя поездка 0» (counter) - outside the batch.
out_of_scope: Blind-reader IA points raised to Eyad, unscored (source-level, in ar too): events under two names (header/footer vs card vs H1); taste card now opens the cuisine page under another name; crafts card has no header/footer counterpart and opens all attractions; plan guide vs my-trip tool and column «Plan» over link «Plan your trip»; long mixed Discover column (ru reader proposes an «About Al-Ahsa» column); souqs+parks+farms header door vs three footer links (owner decision).
Dead keys foot.l.historic / foot.l.nature (all five languages; en still «Nature & farms») are not read by Footer.astro (Discover column uses catLabel) - remove or align in a code batch.
termbase entry 56 note cites «Политика сайта…» as repeating the column title «Сайт» - column is now «О сайте»; the rejection still holds (repeats сайт), wording stale only.
Nativeness 27/30: the 34-character category label is heavy in chips/eyebrows but fits one line everywhere measured.
